strategy.primary: Spellslinger copy: cast efficient instants and sorceries, copy them, and use Parnesse to hand selected opponents optional copies as political leverage. Her first ability taxes opposing targeting by 4 life.
strategy.secondary: Commander-free copy infinites: Narset's Reversal or Reiterate/Reverberate/Increasing Vengeance/Return the Favor with a ritual/copy-mana engine (Alania, Pyromancer's Goggles, Prismari, Thousand-Year Storm, Storm-Kiln Artist, Mana Geyser, Jeska's Will).

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Parnesse, the Subtle Brush
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
Whenever you or a permanent you control becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter that spell or ability unless that player pays 4 life.
Whenever you copy a spell, up to one target opponent may also copy that spell. They may choose new targets for that copy.
